policies.name: missions_brand_delete
policies.using:
(workspace_id IN ( SELECT bu.workspace_id
   FROM brand_users bu
  WHERE ((bu.user_id = auth.uid()) AND bu.active AND (bu.role = 'owner'::text))))

policies.name: missions_brand_insert
policies.check:
(workspace_id IN ( SELECT brand_users.workspace_id
   FROM brand_users
  WHERE ((brand_users.user_id = auth.uid()) AND brand_users.active)))

policies.name: missions_brand_select
policies.using:
(workspace_id IN ( SELECT brand_users.workspace_id
   FROM brand_users
  WHERE ((brand_users.user_id = auth.uid()) AND brand_users.active)))

policies.name: missions_brand_update
policies.check:
((workspace_id IN ( SELECT brand_users.workspace_id
   FROM brand_users
  WHERE ((brand_users.user_id = auth.uid()) AND brand_users.active))) AND private.mission_brand_update_allowed(id, status, points_reward, cash_reward, cpm_rate, cpm_budget_pool))
policies.using:
(workspace_id IN ( SELECT brand_users.workspace_id
   FROM brand_users
  WHERE ((brand_users.user_id = auth.uid()) AND brand_users.active)))
